calls.video_title: T-Mobile Stock: Buy or Sell? | TMUS Stock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: DCF fair value $222 vs current $159 (stated); forward P/E below long-term EPS growth (PEG < 1)
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY, low confidence) — confidence upgraded low → medium on 4 Nov 2026. Fastest-growing of the big three US telcos (EPS growth ~18% vs ~10% AT&T, ~8% Verizon), operating margin nearly tripled in a decade to 21.8%, less debt than rivals; stock at a multi-year low on forward P/E despite the SpaceX disruption threat.
calls.base_case: EPS ~18% growth, ~1m net adds forecast for 2026, margins still improving.
calls.bull_case: Growth and margin expansion continue; SpaceX threat proves manageable and the cheap PEG re-rates.
calls.bear_case: SpaceX disruption with a lower cost of capital (post-IPO ~$2T market cap, ~$100B raised) squeezes all three indebted telcos, which have little room to retaliate.

calls.thesis: SpaceX low-band spectrum deal crushed carriers; near 52-week low at ~$149 vs $223 DCF fair value — buying opportunity on the dip.
calls.bear_case: SpaceX takes more land-mobile share than expected over time.
